findings.text: the place-equality gate never reads whether the checkpoint file still exists, so a checkpoint removed while the pane is idle is not rewritten until the place moves; a reload in that window finds no record and loses the pane memory this change exists to preserve.

_follow_history_caps clamps rows below one to the shipped defaults, so the zero-row branch at reckon/crew/follow_checkpoint.py:333 and its check test_a_zero_row_cap_keeps_no_rows pin a state no flight config can produce; the branch is a defensive guard rather than a reachable cap.

gate-head.log and gate-base.log carry no header naming revision, tree, command, module or cwd, so the node's own four-check claim cannot be bound to the revision it measured from the artifact alone; the sibling gate-follow-watch-base.log does carry that header.

item_verdicts.diff: read all seven changed paths at head; the production commit adds the reported map to the attach event, seeds the follower's map from the checkpointed history on a reload, and gates the checkpoint write on a place tuple, while the docs commit records the same in the archive with one figure.
item_verdicts.done_when: the four named checks pass at the reviewed head and fail at base 80d55621; I reproduced the head arm (4 passed) from the reviewed worktree at e21cb520 and the declared mutation (1 failed at the write-count assertion), and diffed the two suite logs to zero added failures (15 failed/273 passed at base, the four new checks the only base-only reds).
item_verdicts.goal: read both new checks and the follower loop they drive; a reloaded pane now renders the state it last showed rather than the producer's from_state, and an arming idle across twelve polls writes its place at most twice.
item_verdicts.manifest: the reviewed run's manifest reads complete with both commits named, the four checks described, the base and head suite figures, and a bare negative_control_log path whose first line repeats the declaration verbatim.
item_verdicts.write_paths: diff --name-only 80d55621..e21cb520 returns exactly the seven declared paths, four in the production commit and three docs paths, and the plan HTML gained one landing paragraph without touching plan-version or plan-modified.

justifications.durability: the place tuple at reckon/cli.py:2252-2259 covers stream, offset, identity and the reported map, and written_place is set only after a successful write at 2273, but the gate never consults the checkpoint's existence (finding).
justifications.evidence: the head arm reproduces from the reviewed tree (recheck-head.log, 4 passed at e21cb520) and the declared control trips the assertion at reckon/cli.py:2260 with its own message, but gate-head.log and gate-base.log name no revision (finding).
justifications.fit: the change reuses follow_checkpoint.seed_states and the existing checkpoint record rather than a second store, though reckon/cli.py:2622 writes grid._reported directly where a ticker accessor would keep that invariant with its owner.
justifications.goal_fidelity: tests/test_follower_keeps_memory.py:120 asserts the reloaded row's left side carries blocked, and reinstating the guard on reckon/cli.py:2381 and 2401 reddens exactly that assertion.
justifications.scope_discipline: the seven changed paths are exactly the declared set, four production and test paths in 3c712a6b and three docs paths in e21cb520, with nothing outside it in either commit.
